scientific_integrity: Exact deterministic transition-table and four-vector identity certificate; independent exhaustive profile enumerator to length 16.
scientific_limitations: The exact result is limited to binary linear length-three multiset reconstruction with fixed known length; prior regular-language criteria are used and not claimed new. A closely related 2004 paper was unavailable for full priority comparison. No independent audit has been performed.
title: A twelve-periodic quadratic law for uniquely reconstructible binary trigram spectra
